text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond gets injured during
training, so I
rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Owww!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I only moved it a little... It might be
more serious
than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... if all I do is rest, my dreams will
only slip
further away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Resting very well may be the best
option... but I
want to move past this
and grow even more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can overcome the pain... Will
you please
let me keep training?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can overcome the pain... Will
you please
let me keep training?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... while I sit around resting, everyone
else is
out there improving.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. We can't rush these
things, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I still feel disappointed, but I'll try to
use that
disappointment as motivation
once I can train
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After receiving medical attention,
Satono
Diamond returns to her dorm
looking
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Then, let's head back to the
track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I'll be okay. I can handle this...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I took my injury too lightly.
I
apologize...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After putting too much stress on it, her
injury
ends up taking quite a while to
heal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I think I can push through this level of
pain!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Just one step at a time. Don't strain
yourself too
much!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Hehe, I did it! I didn't give in to the pain!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Keeping close attention on her injuries,
Satono
Diamond is able to finish her
training with
astounding self-discipline.
